date_note: Arab News Pakistan's page is dated 25 November and gives no earlier day for the raid.
exec: Pakistan's cybercrime agency says it arrested five people over a call-centre scam targeting US citizens.
geo_basis: location of the raided call centre as stated in the article (Shahrah-e-Faisal, Karachi); city centre coordinates
plain: Pakistan's cybercrime agency says it raided a Karachi call centre and arrested five people accused of defrauding US citizens in a medical billing and health insurance scam.
summary: Pakistan's National Cyber Crime Investigation Agency (NCCIA) arrested five people in a raid on a call centre on Shahrah-e-Faisal in Karachi, Arab News Pakistan reports. The agency said the centre allegedly defrauded US citizens through a medical billing and health insurance scam. The NCCIA registered a case and widened the investigation to other network members and people abroad. Phoneworld Pakistan, citing NCCIA officials, adds that five others, including a bank branch manager, remain at large.
title: Pakistan's NCCIA arrests five in Karachi call-centre raid over alleged US medical billing fraud

validation.note: Arab News Pakistan and Phoneworld Pakistan, two publishers, each report the NCCIA arrest of five in a Karachi call-centre raid. Phoneworld page shows only a Last Updated day of 26 Nov.
